For those who choose to participate in Halloween activities, the Village recommends residents limiting trick-or-treating to 3-7 p.m., on October 31st. Homes that want to participate in Trick-or-Treating should turn on their front/outdoor or festive lights to indicate participation. What if I don’t want to participate in Halloween? When it comes to Halloween, each resident must make the decision as to whether or not they would like to engage festive activities, and if so, to what level they feel most comfortable. If you do NOT want Trick-or-Treaters to approach your home, turning off your porch or outside lights helps to communicate that you are not interested. However, while turning off your front outdoor lights works for most kids, some automatic sensor lights or overly eager trick-or-treaters might still result in occasional knocks. We ask everyone to be a good neighbor and to please be respectful of others and their decisions to participate/n

Search Home Home News Flash Village Recommended Trick-or-Treating Hours News Flash Village Recommended Trick-or-Treating Hours Home Posted on September 23, 2026 The Village recommended trick-or-treating hours are Saturday, October 31, 3 - 7 p.m. As in years past, the Village is providing signs to help indicate whether or not you are inviting Trick-or-Treaters to visit your home this Halloween. Please click on the corresponding links below to view the signs and print them up at home for your own use: 'Trick or Treaters Welcome' Sign 'No Trick or Treaters Please' Sign It is also suggested that those homes participating in Trick-or-Treating leave their front porch light ON during the established Trick-or-Treat hours. This too will function as an indicator for those Trick-or-Treating in your neighborhood.
